استحققن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَقْنَ (istaḥqaqna) /is.taħ.qaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اُسْتُحْقِقْنَ (ustuḥqiqna) /us.tuħ.qiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اِسْتَحْقِقْنَ (istaḥqiqna) /is.taħ.qiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
